quotes.text: Fantastic day on the lake with Cameron! Communicative and punctual, a great instructor for our junior water skiers, and the friendliest guy on the lake. Great boat, great equipment, highly recommend!
A blast. Cameron and the team were super helpful coordinating our group day out on the lake — his knowledge of the lake and the activities made the trip even more special.
Captain Cameron was a fantastic driver and so good at instructing us how to get up on the board. My friends and I had a blast — 100% recommend a day on the boat!
Took me and my girlfriends out for a cruise and ski day and we had so much fun. Captain Cam was so nice and patient. The weather and water were perfect.
Book a trip, you will not be disappointed. Cameron does a fantastic job making everyone feel comfortable and entertained. We'll be repeat customers.
Just an absolute blast with my friends. The captain was great and engaging. Highly recommend. 10/10 experience. Fun for people of all ages.
